```{r}
input_file <- "18_VecF3_R4_S18-Pooled-Cleaning-Reclustering-Initial-Results.csv"    
tmp <- read.csv(paste(root_dir, input_file, sep = ''), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

## Experiment:

```
For each subgroup VHH
  Calculate % Homology from centroid
Aggregate taking average of all distances
```

```{r}
results <- data.frame()
for (clone_id in unique(tmp$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$clone_id == clone_id,]
  for (centroid_id in unique(tmp_frame$centroid_id)){
    tmp_cent <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$centroid_id == centroid_id,]
    # Homology
    tmp_cent$avg_homology_to_cent <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(tmp_cent$centroid[1], tmp_cent$VHH))/nchar(tmp_cent$centroid[1]))*100
    
    tmp_res <- aggregate(avg_homology_to_cent ~ clone_id + centroid_id, dat = tmp_cent, FUN = mean)
    results <- rbind(results, tmp_res)
  }
}

results <- results[order(results$avg_homology_to_cent, decreasing = F),]
```

```{r}
H95_df <- results
```

### Merge together for comparison

**Note:**

Begins with `_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv` file, ends with `-pooled-families.csv` file.

## Load clonal database

```{r}
# Load utilities
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")

file_path <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/phylogenetic_dbs/translated_dbs/19_VecF1_R3_S19_VHH_database.csv"

dat <- read.csv(file_path, header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

```{r}
# Hold results in results
results <- data.frame()
# Iterate over clone ids
for (nm in unique(dat$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- dat[dat$clone_id == nm,]
  
  # Unroll
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "VHH")
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  
  # Pull statistics
  median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
  median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
  
  # Distance from median
  tmp_frame$family_median_VHH_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_VHH, tmp_frame$VHH))/nchar(median_VHH))*100
  
  tmp_frame$family_median_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(median_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(median_CDR3))*100
  
  tmp_frame$family_consensus_CDR3_homology <- 100 - (as.vector(adist(consensus_CDR3, tmp_frame$junction_aa))/nchar(consensus_CDR3))*100
  
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
}

#results <- results[order(results$avg_homology_to_cent, decreasing = F),]
```

## Clone: 207

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))

tmp <- results[results$clone_id == 207,]
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp$family_median_VHH_homology, decreasing = T),]
plot(tmp$family_median_VHH_homology, main = paste("VHH % Homology to most-frequent VHH with CDR3: ", tmp$junction_aa[1], sep = ''), xlab = "Order Statistic", ylab = "Percent Homology to Most-abundant VHH in Family", ylim = c(70, 100))
```
